analysis.summary: Management reported strong Q1 FY27 financial performance with revenue from operations at Rs 133.1 Cr and EBITDA at c. Rs 93.2 Cr, supported by favorable commodity pricing and ongoing drilling execution across blocks like Bakrol, Karjisan, and Cambay. Average sales volume stood at 1,705 boepd, impacted by a temporary timing issue with custody transfer to IOCL that resulted in crude inventory build-up. The company reaffirmed its guidance to reach 2,500 boepd in FY27 as frac impacts are realized from Q2 onwards. Additionally, management highlighted asset updates, statutory refunds, and new license wins under DSF Bid Round IV.

guidance.claim: The company's guidance to reach 2,500 boepd in FY27 remains intact as frac impact will be seen from Q2 onwards.
guidance.quote: Our guidance of reaching 2,500 boepdin FY’27 remains intact, as impact from Frac will be seen from Q2 onwards

guidance.claim: Management stated a roadmap to reach 2,500+ boepd in FY27 starting from a base of 1,800+ boepd.
guidance.quote: We begin our FY 27 with a base of 1800+ boepd with a road map to 2500+ boepd in FY ‘27

guidance.claim: Management remains firm on the production ramp-up trajectory supported by contributions across the onshore portfolio.
guidance.quote: We remain firm on our production ramp-up trajectory, supported by contributions across our onshore portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted a volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment

capex_expansion.claim: Drilling is ahead of schedule with 9 of 10 planned FDP wells drilled so far in Bakrol.
A continuous frac campaign is set to commence in early August in Bakrol with full productivity expected in Q2.
The FDP for 7 new wells in Karjisan is in final stages of approval.
Drilling in Cambay is planned to commence by the end of FY27, with one new well in H2 FY27.
One new well is planned in H2 FY27 targeting either the Western or Central area of the Cambay block.
A second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum

capex_expansion.claim: Drilling of the remaining 8 wells at Bakrol is scheduled to complete in H1 CY2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Remaining 8 wells drilling to complete in H1 CY2026; full ramp-up to follow through mid-year

capex_expansion.claim: Three of four new wells at Karjisan have been drilled with the fourth scheduled onstream in February.
capex_expansion.quote: Three of fournew wells drilled,fourth well scheduled onstream in February

capex_expansion.claim: Preparation of a new Field Development Plan is in progress with a plan to drill further new wells at Karjisan.
capex_expansion.quote: Preparation of a new Field Development Planin progress, plan to drill further new wells

capex_expansion.claim: A workover rig is being contracted to continue testing at Duarmara to establish commerciality of oil zones.
Two of the ten new Bakrol wells were drilled with production ramp up expected from end February onwards and the remaining eight wells to be drilled by mid FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: 2 of the 10 new wells drilled. Production ramp up expected from end February onwards

capex_expansion.claim: The remaining 8 wells in Bakrol are scheduled to be drilled by mid FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Remaining 8 wells to be drilled by midFY’27

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 59% for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Rs 167.5 Cr. (c. +14%) & EBITDA margin at 59% ; Profit After Tax at INR 89.6Cr,up(c.+27%);

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced strong Q-o-Q increase in EBITDA margins despite low oil and gas prices.
Blended price realizations for oil and gas were down by approximately 17%.

orders_capacity.claim: Average sales grew from 1,193 boepd to 1,355 boepd in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Average sales grew from 1,193 boepd to 1,355 boepd, with the meaningful impact felt from Q3 FY’26 onwards as new wells were progressively commissioned

orders_capacity.claim: Average sales for the quarter were approximately 1500 boepd.
orders_capacity.quote: Average sales for the Quarter @ c.1500 boepd

capital_allocation.claim: The company won 2 highly contested onshore licenses in DSF Bid Round IV in Cambay and KG basin and is awaiting formal award.
